title: A day on a film set
scene: Sofia works as an extra on a film set. After the casting she meets the filmmaker and the production designer, the cameraman films a close-up, the narrator explains the setting and the flashback, and the director shows them a preview with footage, suspense, a cameo and a great soundtrack.

title: Grandpa's old films
scene: Grandpa remembers the drive-in and the old music hall. He loves film noir and melodrama, not mainstream films but indie ones, watches a remake as a homage to an old classic on disc, keeps a photo album with negatives, and makes a slide show of retro posters.

scene: Max and a friend want to be game developers. A project manager and one more dev join them to make an RPG with elves, orcs, goblins and a mage who needs mana; the gameplay is simple, players can add a mod, choose an avatar and try a flight simulator.

scene: Max's uncle invites friends to play poker. He tries a bluff, goes all-in and loses to a full house - a real hustler takes his money; then he talks about his trips to the casino, blackjack, gambling and a jackpot, and Grandma says he is a gambler who should play pinball instead.
